title: Revisiting transportation problems under Monge costs with applications to the Discrete Ordered Median Problem
summary: We investigate the classical Hitchcock-Koopmans Transportation Problem under the assumption that the cost matrix satisfies the Monge property. In this setting, we derive compact formulas for optimal dual solutions based on the northwest-corner rule. As an application illustrating how these formulas yield structural insight while enhancing computational performance, we consider a broad class of facility location problems.
